title: Roll out subscribe and manage pages to every Papyrus site as one batch
description:
**Milestone:** M3, public email and new stories

**Goal.** Try on Machines on Machines, the site under test for reader features. Once it works, one batch across the rest.

**Build.**
One PR per site carrying both the version bump and the `papyrus.config.ts` plugin block, so one deploy per site, never two in a row. A site's sending setup comes first (kanbus-313b10). Full reprojection on enable. List sites from the repo, not memory; a site's Slack or Discord reader option needs public-reader registration in Prospectus, which only some have.

**Acceptance.**
Every site's `/notifications/` page answers, in its own theme; Amplify builds succeed.

**Depends on:** PPY-f361ee, PPY-17cf09, PPY-d7443d, PPY-d99539
